  "sentences": [
    {
      "type": "sentence",
      "id": "sentence-1",
      "sourceText": "Artificial intelligence (AI) is a subfield of computer science focused on developing systems that perform tasks requiring human intelligence, such as perception, reasoning, learning, and decision-making.",
      "sourceStart": 0,
      "sourceEnd": 203,
      "targetText": "Artificial intelligence (AI) это подполе из информатика целеустремлённый включить developing systems что perform tasks requiring человеческий интеллект, такой а восприятие, рассуждение, научение, и принятие решения.",
      "targetMarkdown": "Artificial intelligence (AI) [это](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%D1%8D%D1%82%D0%BE \"wikt:ru:это#Determiner:0\") [подполе](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q91327913 \"Q91327913\") [из](https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/%D0%B8%D0%B7 \"wikt:ru:из\") [информатика](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%98%D0%BD%D1%84%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%BC%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B0 \"Q21198\") [целеустремлённый](https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/%D1%86%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%B5%D1%83%D1%81%D1%82%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%BB%D1%91%D0%BD%D0%BD%D1%8B%D0%B9 \"wikt:ru:целеустремлённый\") [включить](https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/%D0%B2%D0%BA%D0%BB%D1%8E%D1%87%D0%B8%D1%82%D1%8C \"wikt:ru:включить\") developing systems [что](https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/%D1%87%D1%82%D0%BE \"wikt:ru:что\") perform tasks requiring [человеческий интеллект](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q5937824 \"Q5937824\"), [такой](https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/%D1%82%D0%B0%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%B9 \"wikt:ru:такой\") [а](https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/%D0%B0 \"wikt:ru:а\") [восприятие](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%BE%D1%81%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%8F%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%B5 \"Q160402\"), [рассуждение](https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%81%D1%81%D1%83%D0%B6%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B5 \"wikt:ru:рассуждение\"), [научение](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9D%D0%B0%D1%83%D1%87%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B5 \"Q133500\"), [и](https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/%D0%B8 \"lex:ru:и\") [принятие решения](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%BD%D1%8F%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%B5_%D1%80%D0%B5%D1%88%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B9 \"Q1331926\").",

    {
      "type": "sentence",
      "id": "sentence-2",
      "sourceText": "The term was coined by John McCarthy in a 1955 proposal for the Dartmouth Conference held in 1956, which convened researchers to explore machine simulation of intelligence for solving human problems.",
      "sourceStart": 204,

      "targetLanguage": "ru",
      "text": "Artificial intelligence (AI) is a subfield of computer science focused on developing systems that perform tasks requiring human intelligence, such as perception, reasoning, learning, and decision-making. The term was coined by John McCarthy in a 1955 proposal for the Dartmouth Conference held in 1956, which convened researchers to explore machine simulation of intelligence for solving human problems. AI research has experienced cycles of optimism and setbacks."
